title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:
Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:


  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital


Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Our US client, is seeking a leader for their Product Development team. This team builds business-critical applications that support customers across the global food and beverage supply chain. They need a hands-on Software Engineering Manager for their Brazil Delivery Center to lead and grow a .NET development team. You will be responsible for recruiting, mentoring, and managing top talent, ensuring high performance and continuous professional growth.


Job Duties:

People & Delivery Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and manage a remote team of full-stack software engineers, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching and feedback, and support career development for team members.
  • Partner with Product Management, QA, DevOps, and other global engineering teams to plan and deliver cloud features aligned with customer migration needs.
  • Own delivery outcomes for the SaaS platform, ensuring predictable, high-quality releases and effective post–go-live support.
  • Participate in hiring and onboarding of new engineers as the team continues to scale.
  • Hands-On Technical Leadership
  • Contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of a SaaS application using the same tools and practices as the engineering team.
  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure.
  • Support front-end development using HTML and TypeScript.
  • Review code, guide architectural decisions, and ensure adherence to coding standards, security best practices, and performance requirements.
  • Leverage AI-powered developer tools and assistants to improve code quality, reduce repetitive work, and accelerate delivery.


Engineering Excellence

  • Promote best practices in software architecture, testing, CI/CD, and DevOps.
  • Ensure appropriate monitoring, logging, and operational readiness using tools such as Application Insights and Kusto.
  • Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives across development processes and team workflows.


Qualifications:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 3+ years of experience leading or managing software engineers.
  • Strong hands-on experience with:
  • .NET / C# for RESTful API development
  • TypeScript / JavaScript and modern web application development
  • SQL databases (Azure SQL or similar)
  • Experience building and operating cloud-based applications on Microsoft Azure.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and secure application development.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to lead distributed, cross-functional teams.


Preferred

  • YAML-based infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience using AI APIs or AI-assisted development tools (Cursor or similar).


This role is CRT and starts at R$20,000/Month

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
  • A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.

title: Senior Software Engineer UX (C# / XAML)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer, UX, with 5+ years of professional experience to join our U.S. client. Candidates must have a strong background in C#, XAML, WinForms, and MAUI.

The ideal candidate will collaborate with a small team in an agile environment to improve our clients' UI experiences by developing new functionality and maintaining existing client applications. You must have experience with UI design, development, and debugging.

Protecting over 17,000 facilities in 80 countries across six continents, our client is a global leader in providing comprehensive visibility into critical infrastructure management, enabling swift problem resolution, waste reduction, and cost efficiencies while significantly elevating operational performance. The company's suite of software solutions enables customers to quickly identify and remediate critical plant issues, elevate plant operational performance, and ultimately drive safer, more efficient, always-on operations.


Responsibilities

  • Seek input from stakeholders, share and review UI mockups, synthesize feedback on usability, carefully consider localization, and empower other team members to create learning materials for the new UI
  • Develop view models, views, custom controls, and UI patterns in C# and XAML in both MAUI and WPF
  • Transform existing WinForms dialogs into reimagined and improved WPF implementations
  • Take ownership of solving interesting problems, architect new objects, improve the solutions of other team members, and maintain the solution as it is deployed globally


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments using C# and XAML
  • Strong proficiency in WinForms and MAUI
  • Ability to contribute across the stack from back-end logic and data modeling to key front-end integrations
  • Strong understanding of component-based architecture, state management, responsive design, and performance optimization
  • Experience working collaboratively with design and back-end teams
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with third-party controls, such as Telerik and ComponentOne
  • Experience with web development, such as Angular and ASP.NET
  • Familiar with Microsoft SQL Server and Entity Framework


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: SAP BTP CAP/RAP
description:
Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) SAP com sólida experiência em extensões na SAP BTP, utilizando CAP e RAP, para atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções cloud nativas integradas a ambientes SAP (ECC/S/4HANA).

Vaga hibrida qualquer cidade.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e desenvolver aplicações e extensões na SAP BTP utilizando CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Implementar APIs, serviços OData/REST, lógica de negócio e integrações com sistemas SAP on-premise e cloud.
  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de aplicações existentes, realizando correções, melhorias e otimizações de performance.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo na área de TI (Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou cursos correlatos).
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento SAP.
  • Experiência sólida com SAP BTP e desenvolvimento utilizando CAP (Node.js/Java) e RAP (ABAP RESTful).
  • Bom domínio de ABAP OO, modelos de dados SAP, CDS Views, OData e conceitos de clean core.
  • Vivência com Git e práticas de desenvolvimento moderno (code review, testes, pipelines básicos).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma, com boa comunicação em times distribuídos.

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Certificações SAP em BTP, CAP, RAP ou S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com SAP Fiori/UI5, integrações com APIs externas e eventos (Event Mesh, Kafka, etc.).


O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Oportunidades para trabalho fora do Brasil
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

  • Plano de Saúde

title: Staff Engineer
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay


Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Objetivos do cargo que você irá atuar: Como Staff Engineer você será uma referência técnica transversal, com forte influência sobre decisões arquiteturais, padrões de engenharia e evolução da plataforma que sustenta todos os times de produto.

Você não estará focado em uma squad específica, mas sim em elevar o sistema como um todo: confiabilidade, escalabilidade, segurança, developer experience e eficiência operacional.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Influenciar e guiar decisões arquiteturais de médio e longo prazo da plataforma
  • Definir e evoluir padrões técnicos para serviços, infraestrutura, observabilidade e CI/CD
  • Atuar como guardião da qualidade técnica, reduzindo complexidade e dívida técnica
  • Trabalhar próximo a Tech Leads, SREs e Tech Managers, ajudando a desambiguar decisões difíceis
  • Projetar e evoluir plataformas e serviços compartilhados (infra, pipelines, templates, SDKs, ferramentas internas)
  • Garantir alta confiabilidade, escalabilidade e segurança dos sistemas em produção
  • Atuar fortemente em observabilidade, troubleshooting e resposta a incidentes críticos
  • Promover uma excelente Developer Experience, melhorando fluxos de build, deploy, testes e operação
  • Mentorar engenheiros(as) de diferentes níveis, elevando o padrão técnico da organização
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas elegantes, incrementais e sustentáveis
  • Tomar decisões orientadas por métricas, dados e impacto real no negócio


Requisitos e qualificações


É imprescindível que você tenha:


  • Experiência sólida como engenheiro(a) sênior / staff / principal
  • Forte domínio em Node.js e Typescript.
  • Experiência profunda com arquitetura de microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos
  • Sólido conhecimento em Kubernetes e ambientes cloud (GCP/AWS/Azure)
  • Excelente domínio de observabilidade, troubleshooting e sistemas em produção
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis)
  • Vivência com CI/CD, automação e infraestrutura como código
  • Forte capacidade de comunicação, influência e mentoria
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas complexas equilibrando negócio, engenharia e operação


Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você:


  • Já atuou fortemente em times de plataforma ou SRE
  • Já trabalhou em projetos de grande porte utilizando Python
  • Tem experiência com arquiteturas event-driven
  • Conhece e aplica DDD, Clean Architecture e Ports & Adapters
  • Já liderou iniciativas transversais de engenharia
  • Consegue explicar decisões técnicas complexas de forma simples


Informações adicionais


Fique por dentro do que te oferecemos:

  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica)
  • Assistência Odontológica (Bradesco)
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) – com extensão para até 3 dependentes
  • Telemedicina 24h – consultas online por chamada de vídeo, disponíveis todos os dias da semana
  • Isenção na mensalidade do SEM PARAR – para 1 veículo no plano Tag Imparável
  • Vale-Alimentação ou Vale-Refeição – você escolhe a melhor opção:
  • VA para compras em supermercados
  • VR para uso em restaurantes no dia a dia
  • Day-off de aniversário (pessoal e da empresa)
  • Programa de acompanhamento para gestantes e licença-paternidade estendida
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Auxílio para dependente PCD
  • PLR

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Contract: PJ

Duration: Open-ended

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern cloud-native technologies while contributing to reliable, scalable systems across multi-cloud platforms.

This is a contract position , open to remote candidates located in North or South America , and will report to a Senior Manager of DevOps Engineering .


What You’ll Do

  • Participate in a regular on-call rotation , responding to incidents reliably and professionally
  • Maintain and evolve AWS cloud infrastructure , leveraging automation and infrastructure-as-code
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform
  • Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines , enabling agile and self-service software delivery
  • Manage and support containerized applications running on Kubernetes
  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineers and other DevOps team members to solve complex technical problems
  • Quickly absorb technical context while ramping up in a dynamic environment
  • Contribute to best practices that enhance system reliability, scalability, and performance


Minimum Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or a related role
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or GCP
  • Experience with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, or similar)
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes
  • Experience with GitOps / CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
  • Exposure to logging, monitoring, and observability tools such as:
  • Datadog
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • ELK Stack
  • CloudWatch
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers working primarily in Pacific Time (PST)


Nice to Have

  • Experience developing automation or tooling using languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., Go, Python, Java, Elixir )
  • Experience building or supporting platform tooling for development, staging, or integration environments
  • Strong skills debugging performance or networking issues in Kubernetes-based applications
  • Familiarity with audit and compliance frameworks (SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS)
  • Working knowledge of UNIX/Linux operating systems
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

description:

Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digital

Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?

Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?

Então essa vaga é para você.

Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.

O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência
  • Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)



O que oferecemos

Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)

title: Android Developer (Realocation to Portugal)
description:
Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in Android development;
  • Hands-on experience with Coroutines or RxJava;
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-structured code;
  • Experience working in collaborative development environments;
  • English level B2 or higher, with the ability to communicate effectively;
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese;
  • Willingness to relocate from Brazil to Portugal;
  • Available to work in Porto or Lisbon (hybrid work model).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: GoHigh Level Specialist
description:
GoHigh Level Specialist

Company: OutfitMD

Department: Operations / Technology

Reports To: CEO & Leadership Team


Role Overview

The GoHigh Level Specialist is responsible for owning, managing, and optimizing the entire backend technology and automation infrastructure for OutfitMD. This role serves as the internal technical authority for CRM systems, workflows, automations, integrations, and platform performance.


This position ensures OutfitMD has full internal control, visibility, and scalability of its systems. The role is highly technical, execution-focused, and critical to the company’s ability to scale efficiently By maintaining strong internal ownership of platform logic and automation, this role enables seamless operations across Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing ensuring systems evolve alongside the business and can reliably support increased volume, complexity, and long-term expansion.


Primary Objectives

• Own and manage OutfitMD’s CRM and automation ecosystem

• Build, maintain, and optimize GHL workflows and automations

• Eliminate dependency on external GHL vendors

• Ensure system stability, scalability, and performance

• Support Implementation, Client Success, and Sales through reliable systems


Core Responsibilities

CRM & Automation Ownership

• Serve as the primary internal expert for GoHighLevel

• Build and maintain workflows, automations, triggers, and pipelines

• Configure forms, calendars, intake processes, and communication logic

• Manage integrations with third-party tools (SMS, email, payment processors, etc.)

• Maintain clean data structures, tagging, and segmentation


Implementation & Technical Support

• Support Implementation Support Specialists with backend builds

• Execute technical setup for new client portals

• Troubleshoot automation failures, bugs, and system issues

• Test and QA systems before client launch


System Optimization & Scaling

• Identify inefficiencies, redundancies, and automation gaps

• Optimize workflows for speed, accuracy, and scalability

• Prepare systems to support increased client volume

• Document technical SOPs and system logic


Security, Compliance & Reliability

• Ensure systems follow best practices for data handling and access control

• Manage user permissions and access levels

• Monitor system uptime and automation health


Internal Collaboration

• Work closely with Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing

• Translate business needs into technical solutions

• Provide leadership with technical insight and recommendations


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Automation reliability and uptime

• Reduction in system errors or failures

• Time to resolve technical issues

• Successful internalization of GHL management

• System scalability and performance metrics


Required Skills & Qualifications

• Advanced experience with GoHighLevel CRM

• Advanced English

• Strong understanding of automation logic and workflows

• Experience with CRM architecture, pipelines, and data structure

• Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently

• Strong documentation and organizational skills

• Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical teams


Preferred

• Experience replacing or auditing third-party CRM vendors

• Background in SaaS, automation, or technical operations

• Familiarity with HIPAA-aware systems (non-clinical)


Why this role matters at outfitmd

The GoHighLevel Specialist ensures our marketing and sales systems run efficiently and produce measurable results. This role is responsible for setting up and optimizing automations, funnels, and CRM workflows so every lead is properly captured, followed up with, and moved through the sales process without manual effort.

By translating business goals into scalable systems, the GoHighLevel Specialist reduces lead loss, improves conversion rates, and supports sustainable growth. This role turns GoHighLevel into a reliable, revenue-driving platform rather than just another software tool.

This position ensures OutfitMD has full internal control, visibility, and scalability of its systems. The role is highly technical, execution-focused, and critical to the company’s ability to scale efficiently By maintaining strong internal ownership of platform logic and automation, this role enables seamless operations across Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing ensuring systems evolve alongside the business and can reliably support increased volume, complexity, and long-term expansion.


Primary Objectives

• Own and manage OutfitMD’s CRM and automation ecosystem

• Build, maintain, and optimize GHL workflows and automations

• Eliminate dependency on external GHL vendors

• Ensure system stability, scalability, and performance

• Support Implementation, Client Success, and Sales through reliable systems


Core Responsibilities

CRM & Automation Ownership

• Serve as the primary internal expert for GoHighLevel

• Build and maintain workflows, automations, triggers, and pipelines

• Configure forms, calendars, intake processes, and communication logic

• Manage integrations with third-party tools (SMS, email, payment processors, etc.)

• Maintain clean data structures, tagging, and segmentation


Implementation & Technical Support

• Support Implementation Support Specialists with backend builds

• Execute technical setup for new client portals

• Troubleshoot automation failures, bugs, and system issues

• Test and QA systems before client launch


System Optimization & Scaling

• Identify inefficiencies, redundancies, and automation gaps

• Optimize workflows for speed, accuracy, and scalability

• Prepare systems to support increased client volume

• Document technical SOPs and system logic


Security, Compliance & Reliability

• Ensure systems follow best practices for data handling and access control

• Manage user permissions and access levels

• Monitor system uptime and automation health


Internal Collaboration

• Work closely with Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing

• Translate business needs into technical solutions

• Provide leadership with technical insight and recommendations


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Automation reliability and uptime

• Reduction in system errors or failures

• Time to resolve technical issues

• Successful internalization of GHL management

• System scalability and performance metrics

• Advanced experience with GoHighLevel CRM

• Advanced English

• Strong understanding of automation logic and workflows

• Experience with CRM architecture, pipelines, and data structure

• Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently

• Strong documentation and organizational skills

• Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical teams


Preferred

• Experience replacing or auditing third-party CRM vendors

• Background in SaaS, automation, or technical operations

• Familiarity with HIPAA-aware systems (non-clinical)

The GoHighLevel Specialist ensures our marketing and sales systems run efficiently and produce measurable results. By translating business goals into scalable systems, the GoHighLevel Specialist reduces lead loss, improves conversion rates, and supports sustainable growth. This role turns GoHighLevel into a reliable, revenue-driving platform rather than just another software tool.

title: Consulting Partner
description:
ERA Group, a global leader in cost management and business optimisation, is looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to join our international network of consultants.

This is not a traditional consultancy role; it’s a chance to run your own practice within a global brand, with the freedom to shape your market, build your team, and grow your client base while backed by ERA’s proven methodologies, tools, and worldwide community.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries
  • Build and grow your client portfolio through business development and long-term partnerships
  • Take ownership of your practice’s strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership
  • Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation


What You Bring

  • Extensive consulting or senior leadership experience in cost management, procurement, or performance improvement
  • A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery
  • Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics
  • Confidence in engaging with CxO-level stakeholders and leveraging your professional network
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the ambition to grow a successful consulting practice



This is the ideal next step if you’re seeking less bureaucracy, more independence, and the chance to build something of your own within a global consultancy platform.

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js / React Native / TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional front-end development experience using React.js, React Native, and TypeScript for our U.K. / U.S. client. You will design, build, and maintain high‑impact user interfaces — from customer dashboards and data visualizations to our React Native mobile app.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature, creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Own front-end delivery for key product surfaces across web and mobile taking features from technical feasibility through technical design, implementation, release, and iteration
  • Build and evolve UI foundations including component patterns, design-system primitives, reusable layouts, and interaction standards that keep UX consistent as the product scales
  • Translate product and design intent into clear, intuitive user flows sweating the details on information hierarchy, micro-interactions, accessibility, and polish
  • Ship performant, data-heavy interfaces in Next.js / React.js, with strong attention to perceived performance (e.g., loading states, empty states, progressive disclosure, and responsiveness)
  • Contribute meaningfully to the React Native app, delivering cross-platform UI and shared patterns where it makes sense, while handling platform-specific edge cases when needed
  • Use automated testing to ensure the UI quality, stability, and performance
  • Partner tightly with Product, Design, and Tech Lead to scope work into thin, shippable increments, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and keep delivery moving without sacrificing quality


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience building production, front-end applications with React.js and TypeScript
  • Experience building and supporting cross-platform, React Native features in a production application
  • Strong eye for UI and UX quality, paying close attention to interaction behavior, information hierarchy, accessibility, and polish
  • Proven experience implementing and operating within a component library / design system (e.g., tokens, reusable components, consistency, and documentation) in close collaboration with Design
  • Strong fundamentals in state management, responsive design, and performance optimization including perceived performance (e.g., loading states, skeletons, optimistic UI, and smooth interactions)
  • Comfortable taking ambiguous product requirements and turning them into clear UI flows, iterating quickly with stakeholders, and owning outcomes
  • Shareable portfolio or examples of UI work (e.g. links, screenshots) as well as the ability to explain what you personally owned and enhanced
  • Proactive mindset and the ability to self-manage in a distributed environment
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • Experience with mobile release workflows (App Store / Play Store), build tooling, and troubleshooting React Native native-module / platform-specific issues
  • Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Recharts) and/or map-based UI (e.g., Mapbox)


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Specialist, Project Finance and M&A, LATAM
description:
About the Company:


Recurrent Energy is one of the world’s largest and most geographically diversified utility-scale solar and energy storage project development, ownership, and operations platforms. With an industry-leading team of in-house energy experts, we are a wholly-owned subsidiary of Canadian Solar Inc. and function as Canadian Solar’s global development and power services business.


About the Position:


The Project Finance and M&A Specialist will play a critical role in supporting the company’s growth across LATAM by performing advanced financial analysis, developing robust financial models, and assisting in the structuring and execution of complex transactions. Working closely with the Project Finance and M&A team, this role provides analytical, strategic, and execution support throughout the transaction lifecycle — from origination and due diligence to closing and portfolio management.


Responsibilities:


  • Business Acumen and Financial Literacy - Demonstrates an understanding of relevant financial metrics and concepts.
  • Resource Planning - Plans for various possible timelines and contingencies for completing assigned work.
  • Collaborative - Displays positive demeanor in interactions with others both on the team and cross-functionally.
  • Project Structuring & Execution – Understands the legal, technical, and financial components of project finance structures; effectively contributes to transaction execution from term sheet to financial close.

title: Analista de negócios sênior
description:
Estamos procurando um profissional com capacidade de realizar a análise de negócios, na área de Recursos Nauturais, orientando a equipe no desenvolvimento e/ou manutenção de soluções de GIS/TI nas fases de Design, Construção, Tecnologia, Requisitos, Teste, Infraestrutura, Configuração e Qualidade.


Formação:

  • Superior completo em Ciências Exatas, da Terra e afins.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento do sistema ArcGIS;
  • Conhecimento de SIG;
  • Conhecimento em TI/infraestrutura;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios;
  • Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de testes.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Conceito de Sensoriamento Remoto
  • Conhecimento na área de Recursos Naturais (preferencialmente mineração e/ou meio ambiente);
  • Capacidade de elaborar Plano de Teste e Caderno/Procedimento de Testes;
  • Conhecimento de DevOps;
  • Certificações;
  • Especializações/Mestrado;
  • Inglês Avançado.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Interpretar documentação e informações de negócio compreendendo processos de negócio mapeados e contribuindo para a definição da arquitetura e implementação da solução e ao atendimento das necessidades de negócio existentes.
  • Criar documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos garantindo o registro do processo e práticas utilizadas.
  • Conduzir processos de Discovery
  • Realizar o levantamento dos requisitos da aplicação
  • Orientar a análise, modelagem e documentação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais.
  • Disseminar o entendimento sobre os processos de negócio necessários à implementação da solução, assimilando e orientando o uso de conceitos e vocabulário próprio das áreas de negócio envolvidas no projeto.
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios.
  • Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de testes.
  • Capacidade de elaborar Plano de Teste e Caderno/Procedimento de Testes de alta complexidade.
  • Avaliar e selecionar as opções da plataforma ESRI que melhor atendam uma respectiva solução.


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?


Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

title: SAP Change Executer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP Change Executer , who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

  • Administration of Linux servers (CentOS, Ubuntu, Red Hat, etc.).
  • Implementation of security policies, patches, and updates.
  • Task automation via scripts (Shell).
  • Monitoring, troubleshooting, and problem resolution for Linux servers.
  • Administration of Windows Server environments (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy).
  • Single Sign-On integration (SAML or OAuth to retrieve information from Active Directory).
  • Management of servers, volumes, clusters, and network services.
  • Deployment and maintenance of services such as IIS and Failover Clustering.
  • Task automation with PowerShell.


Mandatory skills:

  • Advanced knowledge of cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience with containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • ITSM ServiceNow.
  • Database server activities (SQL scripts, backup, database cloning process, etc.). Knowledge of Oracle Database, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL.**
  • Experience with Agile and SAFe frameworks
  • Experience with JIRA , Qtest, TruValt, Mulesoft or Solman
  • Fluent in English and intermediate in Spanish


Desirable Skills:

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and teamwork abilities.

title: Japanese Business Developer
description:
Mayflower is a technology company that alters the entertainment industry to a new level of perception and engagement.

We are developing a partner advertising high-load system with a large RPS, convenient and modern interface. We are growing exponentially and successfully implementing new technologies to accelerate this growth and the system as a whole.

Now we look for a Japanese Business Developer to join our Growth Traffic team


Job Responsibilities

Research and Analysis:

  • Conduct thorough market research on Asian markets to identify opportunities for business expansion.
  • Perform competitive research to stay updated on market trends, competitor activities, and potential market gaps.

Lead Generation:

  • Identify and qualify potential affiliates and business partners within target markets across Asia.
  • Maintain an organized pipeline of prospective affiliates, tracking outreach progress and follow-ups.

Outreach and Communication:

  • Proactively initiate contact and establish relationships with potential affiliates and business partners.
  • Manage initial outreach, clearly communicating our company’s value proposition to prospective partners.

Reporting and Collaboration:

  • Regularly report on progress, including research insights, outreach results, and onboarding statuses.
  • Collaborate closely with senior account managers and cross-functional teams to align affiliate strategies and achieve team goals.


Requirements

  • Fluency in Japanese language is a must
  • Fluency in English
  • At least one year of experience in lead generation or business development.
  • Strong Network: Ability to leverage an existing network of contacts to expedite outreach and sales
  • Communication Skills: Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Self-Starter: Capable of working autonomously in a remote environment, with the motivation to consistently drive results.


Qualification that can be a plus:

  • Proven track of overachieving KPIs in Business Development or Sales positions.


Conditions

We know that great talent deserves great conditions, so here's what you can expect when joining us:

  • Full remote work.
  • Competitive compensation with a service contract.
  • Transparent performance reviews twice a year, with bonus opportunities and salary adjustments.
  • An annual allowance that you can use for home office improvements, sports activities, equipment upgrades, and more—tailor it to what benefits you most.
  • Investment in your development: paid language courses, access to various learning platforms, and a mindfulness benefit, including psychological support with 50% coverage.
  • Career growth in a fast-scaling project with opportunities to influence technical decisions.
  • A culture of recognition: our peer reward program celebrates contributions from across the team.

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA Developer
description:
This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

Cost and capacity management in Azure 

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.


Nice to have:

  • Golang experience


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Desenvolvedor (a) Salesforce
description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and implement scalable Salesforce solutions using Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Lightning Components.


  • Customize Salesforce objects, workflows, validation rules, and approval processes.


  • Develop Apex classes, triggers, Visualforce pages, Lightning Web Components (LWC).


  • Integrate Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs.


  • Perform data migration and ensure data integrity.


  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.


  • Conduct unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning.


  • Stay updated with Salesforce releases and best practices.


Required Skills:


  • Strong experience in Apex, Visualforce, LWC, SOQL, SOSL.


  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce configuration and customization.


  • Knowledge of Salesforce security model, sharing rules, and governor limits.


  • Experience with Salesforce integrations (API, middleware tools like MuleSoft).


  • Familiarity with Salesforce deployment tools (Change Sets, ANT, SFDX).


  • Good understanding of Agile methodology.

title: Data Platform Architect (Remote)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Data Platform Architect with 8+ years of experience to join our U.S. client. The role focuses on designing and building secure, scalable API and service integrations that connect SaaS products, data warehouses, and embedded analytics ecosystems.

The Data Platform Architect is responsible for defining, implementing, and evolving the end-to-end data architecture that powers our platform analytics, reporting, and data automation ecosystem. This role will design a scalable, automated multi-tenant data warehouse and pipeline architecture that integrates hundreds of tenant schemas from our SaaS platform into a centralized, governed, and cost-optimized analytics environment (AWS-based: Redshift, S3, Glue, Lake Formation, QuickSight).The ideal candidate combines deep data engineering expertise with systems-level architecture—balancing automation, performance, and cost while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and scalability for every customer.Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities


Architecture & Design

  • Architect a multi-tenant data platform capable of ingesting 500+ tenant schemas with automated onboarding/offboarding workflows
  • Design an end-to-end architecture that includes data lakes, warehouses, transformation pipelines, and semantic layers
  • Define data zone strategy (Raw Staging Serving), partitioning, and schema evolution patterns
  • Establish standards for data contracts, metadata cataloging, and lineage tracking across all tenants
  • Drive selection and configuration of core technologies (e.g., Redshift, Glue, S3, Lake Formation, dbt, Lambda, Airflow)
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps to ensure infrastructure as code (IaC) is applied to all data assets


Pipeline & Automation

  • Design metadata-driven ingestion and transformation pipelines supporting incremental updates, schema drift, and tenant isolation
  • Ensure pipelines are idempotent, self-healing, and fully integrated into CI/CD processes
  • Partner with the Data Pipeline Engineers to deliver automated data onboarding, testing, and quality validation


Performance & Cost Optimization

  • Define workload management, clustering, and distribution strategies in Redshift or equivalent MPP systems
  • Implement data lifecycle management policies to optimize storage and compute costs
  • Continuously evaluate query performance, caching, and concurrency scaling options


Governance & Security

  • Implement data governance frameworks to ensure privacy, PII compliance, and secure tenant isolation
  • Partner with InfoSec to align encryption (KMS multi-region keys), object lock, and access control policies with SOC/PCI/GDPR standards
  • Establish monitoring, alerting, and anomaly detection systems for data quality and operational stability


Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams to ensure architecture aligns with business and product goals
  • Mentor engineers on modern data platform practices (dbt, ELT, IaC, observability)
  • Act as a technical authority and evangelist for data platform best practices within the organization


Required Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including at least 3 years architecting cloud-native data platforms
  • Proven success in building and maintaining large-scale data pipelines using AWS Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, or Airflow
  • Expertise in Redshift, Snowflake, or equivalent MPP databases, including workload management and query optimization
  • Proficiency with S3-based data lakes, Glue Data Catalog, and Lake Formation
  • Deep understanding of data modeling (Kimball/ELT) and multi-tenant system design
  • Experience defining and enforcing data governance frameworks (PII, access control, lineage)
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation) and CI/CD for data assets
  • Strong SQL and Python skills; dbt experience preferred
  • Familiarity with embedded BI/analytics tools (QuickSight, GoodData) and semantic layer concepts


Desired Experience

  • Experience with schema-per-tenant architectures and automated tenant provisioning
  • Familiarity with Auth0 / SSO integration for analytics tools (e.g., QuickSight embedding)
  • Experience implementing observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, CloudWatch, Monte Carlo, Soda Core)
  • Exposure to data mesh or domain-oriented design principles
  • Prior experience in hospitality / property-management SaaS product ecosystems


Additional Information

  • When you know your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Data Platform Architect (Remote)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Data Platform Architect with 8+ years of experience to join our U.S. client. The role focuses on designing and building secure, scalable API and service integrations that connect SaaS products, data warehouses, and embedded analytics ecosystems.

The Data Platform Architect is responsible for defining, implementing, and evolving the end-to-end data architecture that powers our platform analytics, reporting, and data automation ecosystem. This role will design a scalable, automated multi-tenant data warehouse and pipeline architecture that integrates hundreds of tenant schemas from our SaaS platform into a centralized, governed, and cost-optimized analytics environment (AWS-based: Redshift, S3, Glue, Lake Formation, QuickSight).The ideal candidate combines deep data engineering expertise with systems-level architecture—balancing automation, performance, and cost while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and scalability for every customer.Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities


Architecture & Design

  • Architect a multi-tenant data platform capable of ingesting 500+ tenant schemas with automated onboarding/offboarding workflows
  • Design an end-to-end architecture that includes data lakes, warehouses, transformation pipelines, and semantic layers
  • Define data zone strategy (Raw Staging Serving), partitioning, and schema evolution patterns
  • Establish standards for data contracts, metadata cataloging, and lineage tracking across all tenants
  • Drive selection and configuration of core technologies (e.g., Redshift, Glue, S3, Lake Formation, dbt, Lambda, Airflow)
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps to ensure infrastructure as code (IaC) is applied to all data assets


Pipeline & Automation

  • Design metadata-driven ingestion and transformation pipelines supporting incremental updates, schema drift, and tenant isolation
  • Ensure pipelines are idempotent, self-healing, and fully integrated into CI/CD processes
  • Partner with the Data Pipeline Engineers to deliver automated data onboarding, testing, and quality validation


Performance & Cost Optimization

  • Define workload management, clustering, and distribution strategies in Redshift or equivalent MPP systems
  • Implement data lifecycle management policies to optimize storage and compute costs
  • Continuously evaluate query performance, caching, and concurrency scaling options


Governance & Security

  • Implement data governance frameworks to ensure privacy, PII compliance, and secure tenant isolation
  • Partner with InfoSec to align encryption (KMS multi-region keys), object lock, and access control policies with SOC/PCI/GDPR standards
  • Establish monitoring, alerting, and anomaly detection systems for data quality and operational stability


Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams to ensure architecture aligns with business and product goals
  • Mentor engineers on modern data platform practices (dbt, ELT, IaC, observability)
  • Act as a technical authority and evangelist for data platform best practices within the organization


Required Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including at least 3 years architecting cloud-native data platforms
  • Proven success in building and maintaining large-scale data pipelines using AWS Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, or Airflow
  • Expertise in Redshift, Snowflake, or equivalent MPP databases, including workload management and query optimization
  • Proficiency with S3-based data lakes, Glue Data Catalog, and Lake Formation
  • Deep understanding of data modeling (Kimball/ELT) and multi-tenant system design
  • Experience defining and enforcing data governance frameworks (PII, access control, lineage)
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation) and CI/CD for data assets
  • Strong SQL and Python skills; dbt experience preferred
  • Familiarity with embedded BI/analytics tools (QuickSight, GoodData) and semantic layer concepts


Desired Experience

  • Experience with schema-per-tenant architectures and automated tenant provisioning
  • Familiarity with Auth0 / SSO integration for analytics tools (e.g., QuickSight embedding)
  • Experience implementing observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, CloudWatch, Monte Carlo, Soda Core)
  • Exposure to data mesh or domain-oriented design principles
  • Prior experience in hospitality / property-management SaaS product ecosystems

title: Senior Growth Manager (Brazil)
description:
About us


We are a leading global player in the digital assets industry, operating one of the most advanced and trusted ecosystems in the blockchain space. With a user base exceeding 120 million worldwide, our platform offers a comprehensive suite of digital asset products and services designed to meet the needs of both retail and institutional clients.


Our mission is to accelerate the evolution of the digital economy by enabling secure, intelligent, and efficient transactions. We believe digital assets are redefining the foundations of global finance — and we are committed to empowering that transformation responsibly.


As one of the fastest-growing organizations in the sector, we foster a culture of innovation, integrity, and excellence. For professionals seeking meaningful challenges, cutting-edge projects, and the opportunity to shape the future of finance, we provide an environment that values both expertise and vision.


What you'll do


  • Drive overall business expansion across the Brazil region, setting strategies and delivering measurable growth.
  • Oversee business development, marketing, and operations with a deep understanding of growth levers to boost user acquisition and trading activity.
  • Operate as a true business owner—design new initiatives to elevate operational excellence, refine the local business model, and execute plans end-to-end.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing local team, determining hiring needs and shaping the long-term market strategy.
  • Manage budgeting, P&L performance, and financial goals to meet user and trading volume targets.
  • Lead major local marketing efforts, including partnership development and the execution of key events.
  • Serve as the company’s representative at local events, in media engagements, and in communications with external stakeholders.


What You’ll Need

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience with demonstrated success in a comparable leadership role.
  • Exceptional interpersonal abilities and proven leadership skills with an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • A strong passion for the cryptocurrency space.
  • Native-level proficiency in Portuguese and English.

title: Appointment Setter
description:
Appointment Setter - Fully Remote

About the Job:

We are looking for someone who will be setting appointments with leads, has great written and spoken English skills, has attention to detail and organizational skills.

You will be given various tasks to perform, but your major role is to help us set appointments for our clients' leads. You will be responsible for replying via the text message system with our warm leads on time, booking them into appointments, making phone calls, and asking a few qualifying questions. Full training is provided.

This is a full-time role Mon-Fri for 40 hours per week with occasional overtime. Work time from 8:30am – 5.00pm New York Time (with a 30-minute break). You will be working with US clients, but you can live outside of the US; therefore, we would like to have someone in our team who knows American Culture and speaks decent English. Experience with appointment setting, understanding a fitness niche and/or having a sales/ business/ marketing background is an advantage. The company may offer growth opportunities depending on performance.

Requirements:

  • Strong English skills, a neutral accent, and familiarity with American culture.
  • Commitment to working 8:30am – 5.00pm New York Time.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Passion for digital marketing and a hunger to learn.
  • Experience in marketing or fitness is a bonus, but not required.
  • Attention to detail is a must ( !!!>> When filling out the form, put your postcode as G9999, DO NOT put your real postcode <

  • Join a supportive team.

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind—making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15-30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.


Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants. We help brands discover what actually converts—should luxury skincare shoppers see lifestyle photos or close-up texture shots? Does a supplement brand's product page convert better with per-serving or per-bottle pricing? These decisions matter, and we make it simple to find the answers through visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.


We're scaling rapidly with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores, from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of less than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners—handpicked by Shopify themselves and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.


What sets us apart isn't just our product—it's our world-class partnerships team (deeply embedded with the Shopify ecosystem and Shopify Platinum tech and agency partners) and our customer success organization that ensures brands actually get value from testing. We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem—not just a vendor.


As we accelerate growth, we're expanding our already-strong revenue organization. You'll have direct impact on our trajectory, real ownership over your book of business, and the chance to refine how we execute at scale.

We're a team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.


The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the high-quality lead magnets, ad templates, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters—not through words, but through compelling visuals that show, don't tell.


This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert prospects into customers.


Here's what makes this role unique: We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously—our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, which is one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance here: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps this balance.


The creative challenge? We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world—the people running growth at brands like KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.


You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.



What You'll Do

Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets

  • Design static ad templates for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets (ebooks, guides, one-pagers) that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, without Shoplift vs. with Shoplift) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency


Brand & Sales Materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow \"show-don't-tell\" philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale


Product Marketing Visualization

  • Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
  • Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
  • Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency


You'll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.



You're a Great Fit If...

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency—you build organized, scalable systems
  • You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking—you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with US-based team
  • Portfolio demonstrating marketing design work that shows personality and sophistication (applications without portfolio won't be considered)


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Motion design or animation skills
  • Performance marketing background (you understand what makes ads convert)
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention


You'll thrive if you:

  • Get excited by the challenge of marketing to marketers—people who recognize great work
  • Can take a brief and run with it without extensive art direction
  • Work well asynchronously across time zones
  • Move fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't take revisions personally
  • Care about business outcomes, not just beautiful design
  • Appreciate brand personality and aren't afraid to push creative boundaries (within reason)



What We Offer

Salary: $45,000 - $55,000 USD annually

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer (also Brazil-based) on maintaining design consistency



How to Apply

Applications without a portfolio submitted through this link won't be considered:


When submitting you'll be asked to include:

  • Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)
  • A short note and example marketing asset (3-4 sentences): Show us one marketing asset you're proud of and tell us why it worked.


We're excited to meet you!
