title: Tech Lead
description:
Na Printi, acreditamos que cada detalhe faz a diferença, mas o que realmente importa é você, independente de sua origem, identidade ou crenças!


Somos uma empresa composta por um time diverso e inclusivo de pessoas #Printers, sempre prontas para transformar ideias em realidade gráfica. Valorizamos a pluralidade e buscamos proporcionar soluções para negócios de todos os tamanhos e segmentos, atendendo de pequenos empreendedores a grandes corporações.


Desde 2012, atuamos no mercado brasileiro com o investimento e a expertise do grupo Cimpress, líder global em customização em massa. Com um portfólio extenso, tecnologia de ponta, preços competitivos e prazos rápidos, oferecemos mais do que produtos: oferecemos confiança, respeito e parcerias duradouras.


Venha fazer parte dessa história de sucesso e inovação, com um ambiente de trabalho e soluções que celebram a diversidade e promovem a igualdade. A Printi é grande e, com você, seremos ainda maiores!


Responsabilidades :


  • Atuar como referência técnica da squad, orientando o time na definição de soluções, revisão de código e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir o andamento das entregas técnicas, organizando prioridades com o time e acompanhando o progresso junto ao PM, antecipando riscos e removendo impedimentos.
  • Colaborar com PMs, Designers e QAs desde a concepção, ajudando a transformar objetivos de produto em decisões técnicas viáveis, claras e sustentáveis.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento técnico do time, apoiando na mentoria de pessoas desenvolvedoras e fortalecendo a autonomia e consistência da squad.
  • Garantir visibilidade e organização do trabalho técnico, mantendo a documentação essencial e promovendo o compartilhamento de conhecimento.
  • Propor e acompanhar melhorias contínuas de arquitetura, ferramentas e processos que aumentem a qualidade, estabilidade e eficiência do time.


Requisitos :


  • Formação superior em Ciências da Computação, Sistema de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos como Tech Lead.
  • Vivência em times orientados a produto


Benefícios :


  • Plano médico e odontológico Amil para cuidar de você e sua família;
  • Vale alimentação/refeição, disponibilizado num cartão flexível;
  • Auxilio Home Office;
  • Day off no dia do seu aniversário, para celebrar seu dia especial como merece;
  • Participação nos lucros e resultados;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Total pass, para garantir um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado, para você e seus dependentes;
  • Vittude: 40% de desconto em sessões de psicoterapia online;
  • Desconto de 20% nos produtos da Printi para você aproveitar.

Requisitos :


  • Formação superior em Ciências da Computação, Sistema de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas;

  • Vivência em times orientados a produto


Benefícios :


  • Plano médico e odontológico Amil para cuidar de você e sua família;

  • Total pass, para garantir um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado, para você e seus dependentes;

title: Desenvolvedor React & JavaScript Vanilla Pleno
description:
Sua próxima oportunidade está a caminho!


A VILT é uma empresa de TI, onde valorizamos nosso pessoal, promovemos o trabalho em equipe e, é claro, o bom humor.


Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão fortalecem o nosso time. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, e profissionais com deficiência (PCDs) são incentivados a se candidatar.

Dê uma olhada nesta oportunidade de emprego e veja se você é o próximo VILTian! (se você conhece alguém, não se esqueça de recomendá-lo)


Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Frontend Pleno com foco em React e JavaScript Vanilla para atuar na construção e evolução de aplicações web escaláveis e de alto impacto. O conhecimento em Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) é um diferencial , mas caso ainda não tenha tido contato, é importante ter interesse em aprender e evoluir nessa stack.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir interfaces web com React e JavaScript Vanilla
  • Criar interações diretas manipulando o DOM quando necessário
  • Integrar aplicações com APIs REST
  • Construir componentes reutilizáveis com foco em performance
  • Participar de decisões técnicas e discussões de solução
  • Atuar em code reviews e apoiar na qualidade do código do time
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, com comunicação clara


O que esperamos de você:

  • Mínimo 3 anos de experiência com React e JavaScript
  • Domínio de React: hooks, estado, componentização e performance
  • Forte base em JavaScript Vanilla: DOM, eventos e consumo de APIs sem frameworks
  • Experiência com Git
  • Boa comunicação e perfil colaborativo
  • Autonomia, foco e organização
  • Conhecimento em HTML semântico e CSS moderno
  • Interesse em aprender e trabalhar com AEM, caso ainda não tenha experiência


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com AEM (Adobe Experience Manager)


Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de contrato CLT.


Se você estiver pronto para levar sua carreira de desenvolvimento web para o próximo nível, adoraríamos conhecê-lo!

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Remote – Brazil)
description:
About the job


Company: Hitch

Location: Remote (5+ hours overlap with San Francisco PST required. South America preferred.)

Position: Full-Time


About HitchHitch is a fast-growing fintech building the digital rails for home equity lending. We power lenders like Deephaven and MyEQNow, helping them originate and scale HELOCs, Home Equity Investments, and other non-QM products. Backed by top VCs and featured in HousingWire, we’re transforming how borrowers access their home equity.


The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who wants ownership, impact, and visibility. You’ll join a small but elite remote team (Brazil, Portugal, US) and play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling the next generation of our lending platform.


  • What You’ll DoLead development of high-quality, scalable web apps using TypeScript + Next.js
  • Drive architectural decisions and shape technical direction
  • Collaborate closely with product and design to ship meaningful features fast
  • Mentor junior/intermediate engineers and raise the bar on code quality
  • Build integrations with cloud infrastructure, credit, income, and valuation vendors
  • Optimize performance, scalability, and security across the stack


  • What We’re Looking For5+ years building and scaling web applications
  • Expert in TypeScript, Next.js, and React
  • Strong experience with MongoDB, Redis, Docker
  • Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or other cloud providers
  • Strong communicator, thrives in a remote and autonomous environment
  • Bonus: Zod, tRPC, Prisma, Jest/Playwright, BullMQ, fintech/lending background


  • Why HitchImpact from Day 1: Your code will be in the hands of thousands of brokers and borrowers immediately
  • High-Growth Startup: Join a company that is powering some of the largest lenders in Non-QM (loans for entrepreneurs) mortgage space
  • Elite Team: Work with sharp, collaborative engineers across Brazil, and the US
  • Remote-Friendly: Flexible work, with focus on ownership not hours


How to Apply

Apply here:


  • Tell us why you want to join Hitch and how your skills align with our stack.

title: Brazil Packaging Salesperson, Remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.


Role Description


We are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into Brazilian markets, with a strong understanding of Brazilian business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.


Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.


Responsibilities


The successful candidate will be responsible for:


- Developing and maintaining relationships with Brazilian cosmetic and personal care brands

- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within Brazil’s cosmetic packaging market

- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements

- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting

- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction

- Meeting and exceeding sales targets

- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in Brazilian cosmetic packaging markets


Qualifications


- Proven track record of successful B2B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries

- Extensive experience working with Brazilian cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers

- Strong knowledge of Brazilian cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements

- Fluent in English and Portuguese

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

- Ability to travel to Brazil as needed (20–30% of the time)

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, or a related field

- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools

- Salesforce experience is a plus

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei profissional de desenvolvimento, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos #feras com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



- O que você deve ter?


  • Atuação com desenvolvimento Java (versões mais atuais).
  • Experiência com ecossistema SpringBoot .
  • Necessário conhecimento AWS Services (ECS, EC2, EKS, S3, Lambda, Kafka, DynamoDB ou similar, CI/CD, entre outros).
  • Experiência com testes utilizando JUnit, Mockito, entre outros...
  • Familiaridade com estrutura de microsserviços .
  • Desejável conhecimento em ambiente financeiro, PIX e/ou cobrança .



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Desenvolvedor Pl. / SR.
description:
Sobre a Lockton

Fundada há mais de 50 anos por Jack Lockton em Kansas City, a Lockton desenvolveu uma marca internacionalmente reconhecida pela qualidade e eficiência nos serviços que oferecemos. Graças a lealdade de nossos clientes, que nos permitiu crescer expressivamente nos últimos anos, a Lockton hoje está entre as maiores corretoras de seguro do mundo, conquistando a taxa de crescimento orgânico mais rápida do mercado de corretoras


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend utilizando .NET e SQL Server.
  • Implementar interfaces e funcionalidades frontend utilizando MudBlazor e Vue.js.
  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de sistemas críticos em produção, garantindo estabilidade, qualidade e segurança.
  • Participar ativamente do desenho de soluções, evolução arquitetural, definição de padrões, boas práticas e melhorias de performance.
  • Desenvolver e sustentar APIs REST estáveis e escaláveis, seguindo padrões modernos de desenvolvimento e segurança.
  • Contribuir com o ciclo completo de entrega: análise, desenvolvimento, testes, documentação e melhoria contínua.
  • Participar de rituais ágeis e colaborar com o time para entregas previsíveis e de alto valor.
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente de autonomia, propondo melhorias e novas abordagens tecnológicas.
  • Auxiliar na evolução dos pipelines de CI/CD e integrações com Azure (ou cloud similar).


Requisitos e Qualificações:


  • Experiência sólida com .NET Core e/ou .NET Framework em ambientes de missão crítica.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs REST com ASP.NET WebApi .
  • Conhecimento em SQL Server , incluindo modelagem e procedures.
  • Experiência prática com Entity Framework Core , mapeamento e estratégias de otimização.
  • Familiaridade com ASP.NET Identity Core , JWT e boas práticas de segurança.
  • Conhecimento em MudBlazor e integração frontend-backend.
  • Vivência em ambientes de CI/CD , versionamento Git, testes automatizados e pipelines de entrega.
  • Experiência com times ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e comunicação ativa.
  • Desejável: Experiência com Cloud (Azure ou similar) : App Services, Storage, Pipelines, Logs, Monitoramento, etc.

  • Trabalhar em um ambiente de autonomia, propondo melhorias e novas abordagens tecnológicas.
  • Auxiliar na evolução dos pipelines de CI/CD e integrações com Azure (ou cloud similar).


Requisitos e Qualificações:


  • Experiência sólida com .NET Core e/ou .NET Framework em ambientes de missão crítica.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs REST com ASP.NET WebApi .
  • Conhecimento em SQL Server , incluindo modelagem e procedures.
  • Experiência prática com Entity Framework Core , mapeamento e estratégias de otimização.
  • Familiaridade com ASP.NET Identity Core , JWT e boas práticas de segurança.
  • Conhecimento em MudBlazor e integração frontend-backend.
  • Vivência em ambientes de CI/CD , versionamento Git, testes automatizados e pipelines de entrega.
  • Experiência com times ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e comunicação ativa.
  • Desejável: Experiência com Cloud (Azure ou similar) : App Services, Storage, Pipelines, Logs, Monitoramento, etc.

title: Designer sênior de experiência do usuário
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: UX Designer Senior


Atribuições Requeridas

• Definir visão, objetivos e roadmap do(s) produto(s) de cartão (PF/PJ/Gov ou parcerias), alinhado a estratégia da unidade e metas de crescimento e rentabilidade.

• Descobrir oportunidades com base em análise de mercado e dados (segmentos, concorrência, tendências, regulação), priorizando com frameworks (RICE, WSJF, ICE).

• Especificar problemas e outcomes (PRDs, hipóteses, critérios de sucesso, métricas norteadoras) e apoiar na atuação de ciclos ágeis em conjunto com a tecnologia

• Avaliar oportunidades: aquisição/ativação, engajamento (spend), retenção, cross/up-sell e churn, conectando alavancas (pricing, benefícios, parceria, UX, canais).

• Tomar decisões baseadas em evidências: definir KPIs (LTV, CAC, ARPU, NPS, ativação, inadimplência controlada), ler experimentos e ajustar rota.

Atribuições Desejáveis

• Aplicar técnicas de discovery contínuo (interviews, opportunity solution tree, continuous discovery habits) e product analytics (cohort, funis, causalidade).

• Apoiar go-to-market com Marketing/CRM (segmentação, ofertas, canais, metas, P&L da iniciativa) e orchestrate growth loops.

• Experiência em produtos regulados e integração com bandeiras, adquirentes, carteiras digitais e APIs do ecossistema de pagamentos.


Modelo de trabalho:

100% remoto

Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Senior RPA UiPath Developer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced UiPath RPA Developer to support and maintain an existing automation ecosystem. This professional will work closely with day-to-day operations, ensuring stability, troubleshooting issues, and enhancing current automation frameworks.

The environment includes multiple automation solutions (80+ use cases) built on internal frameworks, recently migrated to cloud infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities

· Maintain and enhance existing UiPath automations

· Perform triage, troubleshooting, debugging, and issue resolution

· Understand current frameworks and improve them over time

· Update and refactor existing workflows

· Ensure stability and performance of attended and unattended bots

· Work with Orchestrator for monitoring and support

· Review and improve documentation and process capture

· Collaborate with business teams on process reviews


Required Skills & Experience

· 5–7+ years of RPA development experience

· Strong hands-on experience with UiPath

· Solid understanding of Selectors, Debugging, Orchestrator, Attended & Unattended automation

· Experience working with internal automation frameworks

· Strong documentation skills

· UiPath Certification

· Fluent English


Nice to Have

· Experience in Finance industry

· Experience working with .NET, Java, Angular, or COBOL systems

· Knowledge of Automation Insights, Maestro, or related tools


Additional Information

· Work hours aligned to U.S. Eastern Time (EST).

· Location: Brazil.

title: ServiceNow Technical Consultant
description:
A Practia está presente em 7 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina com metodologia e equipe técnica especializadas em automação e Hyperautomation.

Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da UiPath, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (UiPath Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da UiPath.

Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor (a) Senior ServiceNow - App Engine & Now Assist , com forte experiência em App Engine e Now Assist para atuar no desenvolvimento de aplicações corporativas, automações inteligentes e soluções baseadas em agentes de IA em um projeto estratégico junto a uma equipe multidisciplinar de analistas, arquitetos e desenvolvedores.


A pessoa selecionada irá atuar em iniciativas avançadas de Hiperautomação e IA, incluindo:

  • Desenvolvimento de soluções para Automação de Processos utilizando a plataforma ServiceNow.
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando App Engine Studio (Low-code e High-code).
  • Projetar e implementar workflows, flows e integrações (ITSM, App Engine).
  • Desenvolvimento de scripts para melhor aderência de soluções ao negócio.
  • Atuar na criação de soluções com Now Assist , explorando:
  • Assistentes de IA para ITSM, CSM e processos corporativos.
  • Automação de geração de textos, resumos, classificação e suporte a agentes.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
Sobre a Posição


Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de Software Sênior para atuar na manutenção, evolução e desenvolvimento de sistemas corporativos, participando ativamente das definições de arquitetura e dos processos de desenvolvimento. O(a) profissional irá trabalhar em ambientes complexos, com forte integração entre sistemas, utilizando boas práticas de engenharia de software e metodologias ágeis.


Responsabilidades


  • Realizar manutenção corretiva e evolutiva, além da codificação de sistemas.
  • Participar de discussões técnicas e definições de arquitetura de software.
  • Atuar no uso de metodologias de desenvolvimento de sistemas e na especificação funcional.
  • Realizar modelagem e mapeamento de processos.
  • Conduzir levantamentos de dados complementares (negócios, integrações e técnicos).
  • Desenvolver e executar testes unitários e integrados.
  • Criar e manter Queries, Stored Procedures, Triggers, Functions e Views.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias do SCRUM (planning, dailies, reviews e retrospectives).


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida com Java 1.8 ou superior, incluindo:
  • EJB, Servlet, JDBC, Swing e WebServices.
  • Experiência com frameworks:
  • Hibernate, Spring, Struts, Aspose, Jasper, Oracle Toplink e Quartz.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de ETL (Microsoft SSIS).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados:
  • SQL Server, DB2 e Oracle.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem de dados.
  • Experiência com UML.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de desenvolvimento:
  • Eclipse, Maven, Ant e SVN.
  • Experiência prática com metodologias ágeis.
  • Inglês em nível intermediário.



Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com .NET.
  • Conhecimento em Oracle PL/SQL.
  • Vivência com WebSphere.
  • Conhecimentos ou práticas em DevOps.


Diferenciais

  • Cursos técnicos ou de especialização na área.
  • Experiência ou conhecimento no segmento de seguros.
  • Certificações técnicas.
  • Conhecimento em Espanhol.

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS) - HOME OFFICE
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location : Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.


You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Onebridge, uma empresa Marlabs, é uma consultoria global de IA e Análise de Dados que capacita organizações em todo o mundo a alcançar melhores resultados por meio de dados e tecnologia. Desde 2005, fazemos parceria com algumas das maiores entidades dos setores de saúde, ciências da vida, serviços financeiros e governo em todo o mundo. Temos uma oportunidade empolgante para um(a) Líder de Engenharia de Software altamente qualificado(a) se juntar à nossa equipe inovadora e dinâmica.


Tipo de Contrato : Tempo Integral

Localização : Brasil – Remoto

Indústria : TI & Serviços


Esta posição exige habilidades avançadas de comunicação em inglês, tanto escrita quanto verbal.


Lead Software Engineer | Sobre Você

Como Lead Software Engineer, você é responsável por impulsionar a visão técnica por trás de aplicações modernas e escaláveis, enquanto orienta uma equipe de engenharia de alta performance. Você prospera na interseção entre arquitetura, desenvolvimento prático e mentoria, equilibrando decisões estratégicas com a paixão por construir software de excelência.

Você gosta de definir padrões de engenharia, elevar as capacidades da equipe e tomar decisões conscientes que influenciam o sucesso do produto a longo prazo.

É motivado(a) por resolver desafios técnicos complexos e criar ambientes onde os engenheiros possam realizar o seu melhor trabalho.


Lead Software Engineer | Atividades do Dia a Dia

  • Liderar o design e desenvolvimento de aplicações complexas e escaláveis usando .NET e frameworks modernos de JavaScript, como Angular ou React.
  • Definir padrões de engenharia, melhores práticas e diretrizes arquiteturais para a equipe de desenvolvimento.
  • Arquitetar e manter sistemas na nuvem seguros, de alta disponibilidade e otimizados para desempenho.
  • Colaborar com equipes de Produto, QA e DevOps para garantir alinhamento entre as soluções técnicas e os objetivos de negócio.
  • Orientar engenheiros, promovendo aprendizado contínuo, qualidade na execução e compartilhamento de conhecimento.
  • Realizar revisões de código para garantir aderência aos padrões de qualidade, segurança e manutenibilidade.
  • Resolver desafios técnicos avançados e influenciar decisões relacionadas à arquitetura e seleção de tecnologias.


Lead Software Engineer | Habilidades & Experiência

  • 7+ anos de experiência em engenharia de software, com proficiência avançada em .NET e frameworks modernos de JavaScript (Angular ou React).
  • Experiência comprovada liderando equipes de engenharia e colaborando efetivamente entre diferentes áreas.
  • Forte expertise em TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 e padrões modernos de desenvolvimento web.
  • Experiência prática no deploy e otimização de aplicações na AWS ou outras grandes plataformas de nuvem.
  • Conhecimento profundo de arquitetura de sistemas, padrões de design e princípios de aplicações escaláveis.
  • Excelentes habilidades de liderança e comunicação em inglês, tanto escrita quanto verbal.

title: Especialista de Operações (Operations Specialist)
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Execute and maintain operational workflows for cross-border payments (including fiat and stablecoin transactions) and VASP activities.
  • Monitor transaction costs, identify inefficiencies, and propose improvements to enhance operational performance.
  • Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
  • Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal risk controls, including KYB/KYC/AML checks, reporting, and audit readiness.
  • Coordinate with banking partners, OTC desks, and internal teams to guarantee smooth settlement, reconciliation, and liquidity management.
  • Develop and implement scalable SOPs and operational tools to support business growth, ensuring reliability and consistency across markets.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
  • Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.


What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.


Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus

Job type: Full Time


Responsabilidades:

  • Executar e manter fluxos de trabalho operacionais para pagamentos transfronteiriços (cross-border ), incluindo transações em moeda fiduciária (fiat ) e stablecoins , bem como atividades de VASP.
  • Monitorar custos de transação, identificar ineficiências e propor melhorias para aprimorar o desempenho operacional.
  • Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, rastreamento de fluxo de caixa e movimentações de fundos em cripto/stablecoins .
  • Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de ativos virtuais para garantir a conformidade com as políticas internas.
  • Assegurar a conformidade com requisitos regulatórios e controles de risco internos, incluindo verificações de KYB/KYC/AML, relatórios e preparação para auditorias.
  • Coordenar com parceiros bancários, mesas de OTC e equipes internas para garantir liquidação, reconciliação e gestão de liquidez tranquilas.
  • Desenvolver e implementar SOPs (Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão) escaláveis e ferramentas operacionais para apoiar o crescimento do negócio, garantindo confiabilidade e consistência entre os mercados.

Requisitos:

  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3.
  • Sólida compreensão de stablecoins , fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional.
  • Fortes habilidades organizacionais e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas com atenção aos detalhes.
  • Fluência em Português e Inglês; proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial.

O que oferecemos:

  • Salário e benefícios competitivos.
  • Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador.
  • A chance de trabalhar com tecnologia blockchain de ponta e causar um impacto significativo na indústria.

Qualificações Preferenciais:

  • Proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial.

Tipo de vaga: Tempo Integral

  • Termos Técnicos: Mantive termos como Stablecoin , VASP , OTC , SOPs e KYC/KYB/AML em inglês ou com a sigla original, pois são padrão na indústria de cripto no Brasil.
  • Adaptação Cultural: O tom é profissional, mas direto, típico de vagas de tecnologia no Brasil.

title: Salesforce Release Manager with COPADO

Fast Dolphin is an international staffing company with over two decades of experience specializing in recruiting bilingual and multilingual IT experts across the Americas as well as providing payroll and customized staffing solutions. Moreover, we take pride in boosting the careers and dreams of our professionals.


We are currently looking for a Salesforce Release Manager to work in a Remote position for a 6+ month with possible extension job opportunity.

Location: Remote in LATAM

Start Date: ASAP

  • Strong planning, estimation, and analytical skills

Languages :

  • English B2

title: Consultor de Vendas
description:
NOSSO MAIOR CRÉDITO É A CONFIANÇA DAS PESSOAS.


Somos um grande time conectado pelos mesmos valores, e para cumprirmos essa missão, acreditamos que a confiança é fundamental nessa jornada.

Queremos sempre estar junto, somando forças e experiências para oferecer o melhor atendimento aos clientes.


Aqui na help incentivamos a participação de variados públicos em nossos processos seletivos, promovendo a candidatura de pessoas negras, mulheres, LGBTQIAP+, acima dos 50 anos e PCDs. Desse modo, não enviesamos perguntas de cunho pessoal, favorecendo e tornando nosso ambiente mais inclusivo, diverso e respeitoso, buscando aumentar a pluralidade dos times.


E nossas vagas são para todos que sintam essa vontade inquietante de pertencer e compor um time único, confiante e forte que tem orgulho de dizer: #somoshelpers!


O que te espera no dia a dia?

  • Realizar prospecção de clientes ;
  • Realizar venda do produto Crédito Pessoal;
  • Cadastrar as propostas no sistema e fechamento de contratos;
  • Atuar na retenção e fidelização de clientes.


Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Perfil do Consultor de Vendas: Proativo, dinâmico, comunicativo, habilidade em negociação, organizado, foco no cliente e metas de vendas;
  • Desejável experiência com vendas e metas;
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office.


Informações adicionais

Local de trabalho: Av. Pref. Jonas Banks Leite, 1005, Registro, São Paulo

Jornada: 100% presencial

Horário de trabalho:

  • Segunda a quinta das 08h às 18h
  • Sexta feira das 08h às 17h


Remuneração:

Salário Fixo

Remuneração Variável

  • Plano de saúde Unimed;
  • Plano odontológico MetLife;
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação;
  • Programa de Incentivo Educacional: Pagamos 100% da sua graduação, pós graduação, curso de idiomas ou cursos rápidos;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Acesse a Wellhub (antiga gympass) , uma plataforma que oferece uma rede de parceiros para atividades físicas e de saúde, ajudando você a manter um estilo de vida ativo e saudável.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.

- VSCode

- .NET Framework

title: Teradata Developer
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


**Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal**


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience ” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • College degree in IT Engineering or similar areas;
  • At least 3-5 years of professional experience in Data Engineering or Data Warehousing;.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Teradata platform ;
  • Good proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and query optimization;
  • Working knowledge of UNIX/Linux operating systems and shell scripting;
  • Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and basic DevOps practices;
  • Experience with Teradata utilities (BTEQ, TPT, FastLoad, MultiLoad, or similar);
  • Good level of English (minimum B2 level)
  • Basic knowledge of French (A1 level) is a plus;
  • Availability to relocate and live in Portugal with our support;


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Autonomy, proactivity, and focus (even under pressure);
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Ability to innovate and evolve in a market in constant mutation.

title: Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno
description:
Descrição da Empresa Handcom é especializada em fornecer soluções de software para gestão de armazéns e centros de distribuição. Com o nosso sistema Mobilize WMS, oferecemos uma solução completa para otimizar e gerenciar eficientemente as operações logísticas dos nossos clientes. A Handcom também fornece soluções de gestão de ativos e inventários utilizando RFID através do Mobilize IoT. Fundada em 2007, temos casos de sucesso reconhecidos no mercado nacional e somos premiados pela Fundação Nacional da Qualidade com o prêmio faixa ouro. Nosso propósito é empoderar pessoas que movem o mundo para o futuro.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações .Net, garantindo performance e qualidade do código. As responsabilidades incluem a implementação de novas funcionalidades no sistema, realização de testes, depuração e otimização . Este é um cargo de tempo integral dedicado e remoto.


Experiências Exigidas – Desenvolvedor Pleno .NET C#

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end com .NET/C#

  • Vivência prática de pelo menos 3 anos  atuando em projetos profissionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços com ASP.NET Core .


Excelência em acesso a dados com Entity Framework Core

  • Experiência em criação, manutenção e otimização de consultas LINQ e SQL.
  • Uso avançado de migrations, mapeamento de entidades e relações complexas.
  • Ajuste de performance em queries e análise de planos de execução.


Prática em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful

  • Implementação de endpoints seguros, versionados e performáticos.
  • Integração com sistemas externos e consumo de serviços.
  • Documentação de APIs (Swagger, OpenAPI).


Aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software

  • Experiência comprovada com Clean Code, SOLID e princípios de design .
  • Criação de código escalável, legível e sustentável.
  • Participação em code reviews  e manutenção de padrões de qualidade.


Experiência em análise de performance e troubleshooting

  • Identificação e resolução de gargalos de performance em aplicações e banco de dados.
  • Uso de ferramentas de profiling e análise de logs.
  • Experiência em logs estruturados e telemetria  (Application Insights, Serilog, Sentry, etc.).


Vivência em times ágeis

  • Experiência trabalhando em squads com Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Participação em cerimônias (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva).
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa em ambientes distribuídos/remotos.


    • Experiências Desejáveis (não obrigatórias, mas valorizadas)
    • Projetos com DDD (Domain-Driven Design) , eventos de domínio e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus).
    • Experiência implementando estratégias de resiliência  (retry, fallback, circuit breaker).
    • Projetos de monitoramento avançado com telemetria e métricas de performance.
    • Participação em arquiteturas escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade.



    Diferenciais
    • Ter trabalhado com Ext.js  em sistemas legados.
    • Experiência em Blazor  (Server ou WebAssembly).
    • Portfólio com projetos relevantes em produção.

description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking to speak with leaders and senior professionals —such as CEO, CFO, director, department head, across sectors who are familiar with International Trade or Foreign Investments.



Qualifications:

  • The purpose of this study is to gain an understanding of the global awareness of city’s attractiveness in trade, investment and partnership. I believe your opinions and expertise would be valuable for our study and I wonder if you’re interested in taking part.
  • CEO, Managing Director, Founder, Director, VP or Head of Department or Senior Manager
  • Have more than 500 employees

  • Please note that, before the final interview, there'll be a 10-minute quick online screener to share more details on the research and to check that this is relevant to you.


Compensation package - BRL 790 for a 30-minute online interview.

title: Java Developer with Kotlin (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • 4+ years of experience in software development;
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java , including microservices architecture using Spring Boot (mandatory);
  • At least 3 years of experience with Kotlin;
  • Fluent English (B2+) is mandatory.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid (1x on-site).


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

title: REPRESENTANTE COMERCIAL AUTONÔMO
description:
CONTRATA-SE REPRESENTANTE COMERCIAL AUTÔNOMO – RCA


Indústria Brasileira de cosméticos atuando a 30 anos no mercado nacional, está selecionando Representante Comercial Autônomo (RCA).  –   Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para profissionais de vendas que atuam nos seguimentos: Supermercadista, Especializado em Cosméticos e Farma. Assim como os distribuidores e atacadistas desses seguimentos.


Perfil do Candidato (Requisitos)

  • Experiência Comprovada:  Vivência prévia em vendas no canal alimentar, Especializado em cosméticos e/ou farma (médio ou grande varejo. Distribuidores e atacadistas).
  • Carteira de Clientes:  Carteira ativa no segmento será um forte diferencial.
  • Documentação:  CNPJ ativo e registro no CORE (Conselho Regional dos Representantes Comerciais).
  • Ferramentas de Trabalho:  Veículo próprio e habilitação em dia.
  • Perfil comportamental:  Boa comunicação, organização, autogestão e foco em metas. 


Atribuições do Cargo

  • Visitas e Prospecção:  Realizar rota de vendas para atender clientes e leads dos seguimentos alvo;
  • Gestão de Carteira:  Visitar clientes da base e abrir novos pontos de venda.
  • Negociação:  Realizar cotações, negociações de preços e prazos.
  • Fidelização:  Manter relacionamento ativo e garantir a presença dos produtos nos pontos de vendas.
  • Ações de Trade:  Promover produtos, monitorar estoque e organizar a visibilidade dos produtos no PDV. 


Benefícios e Diferenciais (Sugestões)


  • Remuneração:  Comissionamento atrativo acima da média de mercado, baseado no volume de faturamento.
  • Incentivos:  Premiações por alcance de metas, positivação de clientes e campanhas da indústria.
  • Flexibilidade:  Liberdade de gestão da própria agenda e possibilidade de atuar com portfólios complementares (não exclusivos). 

Sobre a contratação

  • Modelo:  PJ (Pessoa Jurídica), sem vínculo empregatício CLT.

title: Customer Success Consultant
description:
Customer Success & Business Development Consultant – Latin America

CAS uses intuitive technology, unparalleled scientific content, and unmatched human expertise to help companies create groundbreaking innovations that benefit the world. As the scientific information solutions division of the American Chemical Society, CAS manages the largest curated reservoir of scientific knowledge and, for over 115 years, has helped innovators mine, assess, and apply that information to keep businesses thriving. The CAS team is global, diverse, endlessly curious, and strives to make scientific insights accessible to innovators worldwide.


CAS is seeking an independent consultant to support delivering services that combine customer success expertise with business development activities, focusing on consultative engagement, solution-oriented selling, and collaborative account management.


Key Deliveries include:

Customer Success & Engagement

  • Facilitate onboarding and enablement sessions for CAS users.
  • Provide guidance to help customers realize the full value of CAS solutions.
  • Maintain strong relationships across multiple levels within client organizations.

Business Development

  • Identify opportunities to grow, retain, and cross-sell within existing accounts.
  • Develop a pipeline of new business opportunities in the assigned territory.
  • Conduct prospecting activities, including calls, emails, and presentations.

Strategic Communication

  • Deliver compelling presentations and messaging to build awareness of CAS solutions.
  • Support marketing activities such as workshops, seminars, and industry events.
  • Represent CAS at conferences and trade shows as agreed.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate records of activities and opportunities in CRM (Salesforce/LEX).
  • Provide regular progress updates on engagement metrics and deliverables.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a science-related field (preferred).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in sales, account management, customer success, and business development.
  • English fluency (written and spoken); Portuguese required; Spanish is a plus.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems (Salesforce/LEX) and virtual meeting tools (Teams, Zoom, WebEx).
  • Dynamic, proactive, and collaborative mindset.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).


Required Expertise:

  • Proven success in solution-based sales and consultative engagement.

description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa profissional para integrar nosso time, atuando em iniciativas criativas e de inovação, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de soluções de design que apoiem objetivos de negócio e comunicação em diferentes canais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Você será responsável por:

  • Criar e entregar materiais de design para apoiar iniciativas de marketing, comunicação e produtos digitais
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para compreender necessidades de negócio e traduzi-las em soluções visuais
  • Garantir consistência com diretrizes de marca, padrões visuais e sistemas de design
  • Gerenciar múltiplas demandas de design, assegurando qualidade e cumprimento de prazos
  • Manter documentação relacionada a processos, padrões e componentes de design
  • Participar de reuniões de projeto, revisões e rituais do time
  • Comunicar status, riscos e dependências para as partes interessadas

Requisitos e qualificações

Para essa posição é importante que você tenha:

  • Experiência prévia em funções relacionadas a design
  • Sólidos fundamentos de design visual (tipografia, cor, composição e layout)
  • Experiência com entregáveis digitais e/ou de marketing
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes colaborativos e ágeis
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal
  • Organização e habilidade para lidar com múltiplas prioridades
  • Inglês avançado


Seria legal se você tivesse:

  • Experiência com sistemas de design ou diretrizes de marca
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas modernas de design e colaboração
  • Vivência em times globais ou multidisciplinares
  • Conhecimento de produtos digitais, marketing ou ambientes de tecnologia

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer for a 100% Remote, 6 month +, 1099 contract


No 3rd Party C2Cs Please.


Location: Brazil or Colombia, South America (work remote supporting US based client/project)

Employment Type: Contract Work, 40 hours weekly


100% Requirement: Must have good verbal & written communication (English)


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer IV to lead technical initiatives, tackle complex engineering challenges, and provide mentorship to the team. This role requires expertise in software development, leadership in driving projects, and the ability to design scalable solutions. The ideal candidate will manage the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive project success.


In This Role You Will:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and deliver project requirements
  • Ensure engineering best practices are followed throughout development
  • Contribute to system architecture and design discussions


Core Competencies for success:

  • Expertise in at least one critical system/service and recognized leadership in that area
  • Proven track record of delivering high-quality software solutions
  • Ability to estimate project costs and resource needs
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills
  • Commitment to continuous learning and innovation


Requirements:

  • Preference for engineers with full-stack proficiency, particularly in Vue.js
  • Proficiency in backend development using Python, SQL, MongoDB and AWS
  • Extensive experience designing and implementing scalable software solutions
  • Strong expertise in software development methodologies and best practices
  • Experience leading teams and managing software projects

description:
Freelance Regulatory & Study Start-Up Specialist – LATAM - Brazil, Chile and Argentina


Upsilon Global are seeking a freelance regulatory and start-up specialist with solid experience in Ethics Committee submissions for observational studies in LATAM, specifically Chile, Argentina and Brazil.


The role will provide centralized oversight and execution of local submissions across the three countries to ensure quality, consistency and timeline adherence.


Key Details:

Start Date: February 2026

Contract Length: 6 months initially

FTE: Approximately 0.5 FTE

Therapeutic Area: Observational/RWE - infectious diseases

Location: Remote, covering Brazil, Argentina and Chile


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage regulatory submissions and site start-up activities.
  • Ensure compliance with Swiss and international clinical trial regulations.
  • Liaise with sponsors, investigators, and ethics committees.
  • Track approval timelines and maintain regulatory documentation.
  • Provide guidance on regulatory requirements and study compliance.

  • EC submissions for observational studies
  • Experience managing submissions across multiple countries
  • Familiarity with projects including satellite sites
  • Proactive and solution-oriented
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Ability to work under tight timelines

Experience:

  • EC submission expertise
  • Knowledge of LATAM regulatory landscapes
  • Hands-on experience with EC submissions in LATAM
  • Ability to work independently and drive submissions end-to-end
  • Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills

title: Senior Cloud SRE
description:
Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer

As a Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer , you will join a specialized engineering task force dedicated to preventing and resolving the most critical and strategic customer issues encountered in the field.

Our global team of experienced engineers has a deep understanding of the lower layers of private cloud infrastructure. Together, we work on practical solutions, continuously learning and adapting. We collaborate closely, share knowledge, and tackle challenges head-on.

If you're an engineer eager to understand the core of cloud technologies and looking for a team that values hands-on expertise , you'll fit right in with us.


What you will learn and contribute to

  • Maintain and enhance Red Hat private cloud: You’ll work extensively with Nokia Container Services (NCS) and CloudBand Infrastructure Software (CBIS) , private cloud solutions based on Kubernetes and OpenStack .
  • Deep Dive Troubleshooting: Starting from high-level Kubernetes error messages, you’ll navigate through multiple layers until pinpointing issues—even down to kernel-level bugs.
  • Automate and Develop: Spend 30–50% of your time developing automation to prevent recurring issues. Solve it once, automate for the future. Use your Python skills to create health checks and improve reliability.
  • Continuous Learning: In our rapidly evolving tech landscape, ongoing learning is a cornerstone.
  • Collaborate with Developers and Engineers: Work closely with developers and product engineers to bridge infrastructure and software, ensuring seamless product delivery.
  • Mode of Operation: This role requires participation in a follow-the-sun scheme with 12-hour shifts (within regulatory limits) or participation in on-call rotations to ensure business continuity during emergencies.


Your skills and experience

  • Linux Expertise: Strong familiarity with Linux distributions; we primarily use Red Hat and CentOS .
  • Networking Foundations: Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (VLANs, IP routing). Experience with Calico , Multus , and Open vSwitch is a plus.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Excellent troubleshooting skills and analytical thinking to address complex challenges.
  • Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in Bash and Python , or willingness to learn, plus familiarity with Ansible .

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
English-speaking Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure or AWS)


$4,000 – $6,000 USD/month

Fully Remote

Full-time, long-term contract

Excellent English skills required for this position


About the Company


Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP that delivers end-to-end cloud solutions to enterprise clients across the US.


Their teams design, manage, and optimize complex Azure and AWS environments for global organizations — helping businesses modernize infrastructure, reduce costs, and adopt automation-first cloud operations.


You’ll be part of a senior, high-performing Cloud Center of Excellence : a small, elite group of engineers who are the “go-to” specialists when others can’t solve it.

This is a long-term, stable remote opportunity to grow your career in a world-class engineering environment — without the red tape or endless ticket queues.


The Role


As a Senior Cloud Engineer , you’ll act as both an engineer and consultant — supporting, optimizing, and automating large-scale public cloud environments across Azure and AWS .

This is not a traditional support role — you’ll have direct customer interaction, ownership of infrastructure automation, and the freedom to solve complex challenges creatively.

You’ll work on:


  • Supporting and optimizing enterprise-scale Azure and AWS environments
  • Building automation frameworks using Terraform, Ansible, and GitOps principles
  • Proactive governance and cost optimization reviews using Cloud Insights (Flexera CloudCheckr)
  • Designing and deploying Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep)
  • Advising customers on modernization, containers (AKS/EKS), and cloud-native adoption
  • Collaborating with Product and Professional Services teams on new initiatives and deployments


What You’ll Bring


  • 5+ years’ experience as a Cloud Engineer / DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Azure OR AWS (ideally both)
  • Proven experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Experience with Kubernetes (AKS, EKS) and cloud-native services (App Services, Lambda, etc.)
  • Understanding of networking, hybrid connectivity, and governance best practices
  • Exposure to automation tools such as Ansible, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience working in a customer-facing or MSP environment
  • Fluent English communication skills


Who You Are


  • A problem-solver who loves tackling complex challenges others can’t fix
  • A self-starter who learns fast and enjoys exploring new technologies
  • A consultative communicator , confident working directly with enterprise clients
  • Someone who’s passionate about continuous improvement and multi-cloud growth
  • A team player who wants to be part of a small, world-class engineering group


Why You’ll Love It Here


✅ Work fully remote from anywhere

✅ Competitive pay: $4,000 – $5,500 USD/month

✅ Stable, long-term engagement with a US enterprise client base

✅ Strong focus on career development & certifications (covered every 6 months)

✅ Exposure to cutting-edge multi-cloud environments and automation frameworks

✅ Collaborative, senior-level engineering culture — no micromanagement, no bureaucracy

description:

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. Advanced/Fluent English

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.


Contract Type


Full-time

title: Sr. Procurement Analyst -80% Spanish
description:
About the Job


Sr. Procurement Analyst will execute and manage Indirect spend categories' strategic sourcing and procurement across all supply chain operations facility types agreed to be in-scope and will deliver business requirements providing the best value to key business stakeholders.The focus will be managing the end-to-end strategic sourcing process and all in-scope elements of indirect spend for LATAM with emphasis on Brazil and the rest of the countries of South America (not limited).


Scope: Regions: Americas (subregion: LATAM)


Languages : Portuguese and Spanish 90%


Key Responsibilities May Include:


  • Develop and execute category strategies aligned with regional and global procurement priorities, leveraging market analysis to optimize supplier selection and performance.
  • Lead end-to-end sourcing activities, including negotiating contracts, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
  • Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities within assigned categories to meet annual savings targets and drive value for the business.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to align procurement activities with business needs and ensure early involvement in the sourcing process.
  • Monitor supplier performance against key performance indicators (KPIs) and address gaps to improve quality, delivery, and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure procurement activities adhere to governance, ethical sourcing practices, and sustainability objectives while supporting audit and compliance requirements.
  • Provide regular reporting and analytics on procurement performance, including spend analysis, cost savings, and supplier performance metrics.
  • Collaborate with global category managers and cross-functional teams to leverage scale, align strategies, and drive procurement initiatives effectively.



Experience- What you will bring


  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred (Business, Supply Chain, or Engineering).
  • Operations support experience.
  • 4+ years of procurement experience supporting business operations with YoY savings.
  • Strong supplier segmentation, supplier performance and relationship management
  • experience
  • Experience in business operations, or supporting operations, at a large
  • multinational company.
  • Strategic Sourcing knowledge and experience (7-Step Process).
  • Procurement/Purchasing Experience +5 years
  • Contract negotiations.
  • Customer service minded.



Skills & Knowledge

Strong Negotiation and commercial contracting skills specially in professional services,

facilities and maintenance (MRO).

• Use of computer tools such as Microsoft Excel, Coupa, CLMs.

• Knowledge of plant operations preferred.

• This role demands continuous interaction with key stakeholders within Brambles Supply

Chain and Corporate Business.

• Data Analytics (Intermediate level Excel to include Pivot tables, formulas, etc.) with

development potential.

title: Executive Assistant | Fully Remote | English Speaking
description:
Brazilstrat connects top-tier Brazilian remote talent with organizations abroad. We are currently selecting an Executive Assistant to join a fast-paced, dynamic international scaleup , supporting the CEO and Founder.


In this role, you will work remotely as a strategic partner to leadership. This is an ideal position for a proactive, organized professional looking to work closely with C-level management in a global environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Operational Excellence: efficiently manage complex calendars, international travel logistics, and inbox triage to ensure the CEO’s day-to-day runs smoothly.
  • Strategic Support: act as a partner to the CEO by leading ad-hoc business projects, conducting market research, and preparing briefing materials to support decision-making.
  • Communication & Reporting: prepare high-quality presentations (decks), reports, and meeting minutes for board meetings and internal strategy sessions.
  • Force Multiplier: facilitate cross-functional communication and handle operational roadblocks, allowing leadership to focus on high-impact strategy.


Requirements:

  • Fluent English (spoken and written) is mandatory.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Tech-savvy: proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and productivity tools like Notion. Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively to increase efficiency is highly valued.
  • Proactive mindset: you are a problem solver who addresses issues before they become emergencies.
  • High emotional intelligence and professional discretion.


What We Offer:

  • 100% remote, home-office flexibility.
  • Direct exposure to C-Level leadership and business operations.
  • Growth opportunities within a rapidly scaling international company.

Note: Only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps.

title: Consultor (a) Devops - Kubernetes
description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos


Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.


Job Description & Responsibilities:




  • English Advanced



• The role involves designing and executing test plans for enterprise network software solutions, validating performance, reliability, and scalability in Kubernetes-based environments, and developing automation scripts using Bash and Python.




• Candidates should have experience with Linux and Windows OS, networking protocols like BGP, TCP/IP, and IP subnetting. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Ansible, and troubleshooting network issues is essential.
